title: Tell unsupported run-file entries apart from transient read failures in the run JSON reader
outcome: test_run_read_json reports a run file that is not a regular file, or is a symlink, as its own outcome, distinct from an io error or a version race. The verification-record producer and the run-wait follow-up then treat an unsupported request or results entry as definite (no record) rather than retrying it forever, while genuine transient read failures still retry.
acceptance: Tell unsupported run-file entries apart from transient read failures in the run JSON reader is done
